::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [May ?1860s  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown. Photocopies lent by Barbara Dennis: Maggie/6
:::

My dear [Maggie](people/person_83.qmd)
I wish you many happy returns of the day, and I wish I was sending you a [Daisy Chain](cmy_books/cmybook_24.qmd) with it, but I did not write a letter in time to get it from London, so I am afraid you must wait for it till the next day, but it will be something to look forward to then, and I will write your name in it, if you like on Friday evening

your affectionate godmother
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Maggie Moberly was born in 1852 and *The Daisy Chain* seems most likely to have been offered her after the age of 8 and before the age of 18.
